market_source: Yahoo Finance daily adjusted-close chart responses, archived unchanged with retrieval time and SHA-256. Public endpoint availability is not guaranteed; ETF adjusted returns are proxies, not official index total returns.
universe_rule: Fixed set of human-verified active assets with at least 90% calendar close coverage over the frozen window. Report excluded assets. Membership is retrospective and creates survivorship/selection limitations.
portfolio_rule: Daily-rebalanced equal-weight simple returns over the fixed eligible set, compounded between matched benchmark session endpoints. Every daily constituent return is required; no reweighting over missing assets and no fill across missing crypto calendar days. Costs excluded.
primary_frequency: Weekly: final common benchmark session in each ISO week; only successive weekly endpoints 4-10 calendar days apart are used. Weekly endpoints aggregate all intervening crypto returns including weekends.
robustness: crypto closes shifted -1 and +1 calendar day against fixed benchmark endpoints
equal weight excluding BTC and ETH

uncertainty.method: circular moving-block bootstrap of paired weekly returns

inference: Three primary basket-benchmark correlations with percentile intervals; all other asset, group and sensitivity results are descriptive, without p-values or significance selection. No confirmatory significance or multiple-testing rejection claims.
timing: ETF session date follows America/New_York. Crypto daily-close dates follow the archived UTC daily bar labels. Closes are not synchronized at 16:00 ET; weekly aggregation and +/-1-day shifts assess sensitivity, not eliminate it.
guardrails: Correlations use matched returns, never price levels. No weekend or holiday price forward filling.
Benchmark and crypto returns use identical endpoint dates within each scenario. Quote currency differs: crypto USDT prices versus ETF USD prices; depeg basis risk remains.
Correlation is an association, not causation, diversification assurance, or safe-haven proof. Equity-down correlations are regime diagnostics and may have small samples.
Function groups overlap and are exploratory descriptions; contemporary verified codes do not reconstruct historical information sets.
The one-year primary sample cannot establish relationships across multiple market cycles. Market-data coverage ends August 2026 and is not a current October market view.
Retain existing H1-H4/H8 and RV1 outputs. This is a separately frozen exploratory CA1 extension, not independent confirmation of earlier results.
